message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **Code Enforcement Division** rather than the city council itself. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal:
• Select “Noise” or “Public Safety” and follow the prompts to submit your complaint. | N/A | | **Phone** | • Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line: **404‑656‑4000**
• Tell them you’d like to file a noise complaint and provide the address, time, and description of the disturbance. | 404‑656‑4000 | | **In‑person** | • Go to the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office.
• Fill out a noise‑complaint form and hand it to a clerk. | City Hall – 1000 Peachtree St NE, Atlanta, GA 30308 | | **Email** | • Send an email to the Atlanta Police Department’s public safety email: **publicsafety@atlantaga.gov**
• Include the same details as above. | publicsafety@atlantaga.gov | ### Tips for Filing 1. **Be Specific** – Include the exact address, the time(s) of the disturbance, and a brief description (e.g., loud music, construction noise, barking dogs). 2. **Document Evidence** – If possible, record a short audio clip or take photos that illustrate the noise level or source. 3. **Follow Up** – After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Use this number when following up with the police or code enforcement. ### When to Call 911 If the noise is part of an emergency (e.g., a fire, active shooter, or other immediate danger), call **911** instead of filing a standard noise complaint. --- Feel free to use any of the methods above to report the noise issue. The city’s goal is to keep neighborhoods peaceful, so they’ll investigate and take appropriate action.
